name: Hot afternoon in the open
description: Batch left in an open yard at 33-38 C for 6 h waiting for a trader, then 30 C into the evening.
expected_story: Fast decay: 6 h at 33-38 C consumes roughly 13% (tomato) to 23% (guava) of shelf life before the batch even moves. This is the status-quo side of the 18% vs 7% loss comparison.
